item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #6
item.description: The vile threat of Cthulhu has brought every mythical monster together once again to defeat him! But a crazed, Cthulhu-mad Lorren will not be easily shut down, and when he threatens Korbin’s son, the claws of the wolf come out. "Monster mash" takes on a whole new meaning in this action-packed conclusion to the second Broken Moon mini-series!
